question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Reverence
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3** (Scorn)'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** 'Reverence'** signifies deep respect or awe for someone or something.(श्रद्धा)
 
• The word **'Scorn'**, on the other hand, implies the feeling or expression of contempt or disdain.(घृणा) 
 
• Thus, **'Scorn'** is an antonym of** 'Reverence'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is-** 'Scorn'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1** 'Venerate'**, meaning to regard with great respect; revere, is a synonym, not an antonym.(आदर करना)
 
• Option 2** 'Honour',** meaning high respect, is also a synonym, not an antonym.(सम्मान)
 
• Option 4** 'Deference'**, implying humble submission and respect, is a synonym, not an antonym. (आदर)
